events.summary: Already present in the earliest snapshot:48 public Request-named messages, including authentication/local chat/skill-plan APIs; six public services/nine methods and notice-user sint32. This does not date their introduction.
TokenBalanceRequest, SmartCharacterExistsRequest and MetaTransactionRequest first appear:public request catalog48→51.
Public smart-storage InventoryRequest first appears:51→52 requests.
Four external-industry facility/inventory/job requests first appear:52→56. Public eve_public.client.Connected first appears with string session_id.
Public Connected.session_id changes string→int64 relative to2763641; internal eve.client.event.Connected retains a separate string field.
Internal eve.payment.product.GetRequest first appears with bool active_only field1; this is not an enabled public API proof.
Public and internal MetaTransactionResponse first carry string transaction_hash field2; all earlier occurrences of that response lack it.
Two smart-character private-key requests first appear:56→58. Page/NextPage helpers and TraceContext.state field4 are first observed.

32 requests first appear:assembly energy/metadata/online/offline, owned gates, network-node fuel, relay lenses, storage, zklogin, web3-character creation, token exchange and wallet balance;58→90. Legacy TokenBalanceRequest first gains deprecated metadata. Internal character/crown/shell progression events and prepared-sponsored-transaction types also first appear.

16 requests first appear:10 Creation desired-state/fuel/network-inventory requests,4 exploration requests and2 virtual-ledger user-balance requests;90→106. Internal memory/shell identifiers and crown/memory/shell requests first appear. Flight analytics includes Thrusted; internal product query field1 is now a typed Identifier; ItemsScooped uses items field4.

First bundled heartbeat/FPS telemetry and Braked/Aimflight flight analytics, with Thrusted absent on this branch. First internal docking-point/game-access-entitlement/NPC-harvest models/events. ItemsScooped now uses wrapped scooped_items field5 instead of field4. Public request catalog remains106.

First public/internal gateway drain bool field4, composite-asteroid internal models/events, typed progression category/crown/skill identifiers and memory-depth/events, and prepared-sponsored-transaction execute-token fields. Public request catalog remains106.

scopeNotes: First observed refers to the earliest saved snapshot meeting the named module/consumer/descriptor criteria, not the original introduction or public release date.
Earliest2455427 observations are already present and cannot be dated further with this archive set.
Generated descriptors, empty module initializers, static definitions, consuming client logic and live feature acceptance are separate levels of evidence.
Different branches can omit a system or change defaults. Absence in a later snapshot is not proof of global removal.
Catalog indexing can be observed when cached payloads are missing; first verified bytes are recorded separately.

calendarDateEvidence.reason: Identity records expose build/sync, version/codename and branch, but no authoritative release/build date. All recorded2026-10-27 values are audit dates. Branch2024/2026labels, extraction/file mtimes, source pyc timestamps and runtime interpreter build strings are not release dates.
